spec_provided_observability.name: STATUS WORD (RT → BC)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-message observability of the addressed RT. 9 condition bits: Message Error, Instrumentation, Service Request, Broadcast Command Received, Busy, Subsystem Flag, Dynamic Bus Acceptance, Terminal Flag (+ RT address echo for verification).

spec_provided_observability.name: MESSAGE ERROR bit (Status Word bit 6)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT signals to BC that an error was detected in the BC's preceding command sequence; RT will not transmit data when this bit is set.

spec_provided_observability.name: SERVICE REQUEST bit (bit 8)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT requests an acyclic / out-of-schedule transfer; BC typically responds by issuing the Transmit Vector Word mode code.

spec_provided_observability.name: BUSY bit (bit 13)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT cannot service the command this cycle (subsystem not ready); BC may retry later.

spec_provided_observability.name: SUBSYSTEM FLAG bit (bit 14)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT signals subsystem-level fault (driven from subsystem behind the RT interface).

spec_provided_observability.name: TERMINAL FLAG bit (bit 16)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT-internal fault (e.g. BIT failure); can be inhibited via Inhibit Terminal Flag mode code.

spec_provided_observability.name: DYNAMIC BUS ACCEPTANCE bit (bit 15)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Acknowledgement of Dynamic Bus Control mode code — RT accepts BC role.

spec_provided_observability.name: BROADCAST COMMAND RECEIVED bit (bit 12)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RT confirms (out-of-band on next Transmit Status query) that the last command was a broadcast.

spec_provided_observability.name: BIT WORD (mode code 10011)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Mandatory Built-In-Test word — RT-defined 16-bit health vector returned on request.

spec_provided_observability.name: TRANSMIT LAST COMMAND (mode code 10010)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Mandatory — RT echoes the last Command Word it received; lets BC diagnose lost / corrupted commands.

spec_provided_observability.name: TRANSMIT STATUS WORD (mode code 00010)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Mandatory — RT re-issues its current Status Word without performing a data transfer; used by BC to poll RT health.

spec_provided_observability.name: BUS MONITOR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Passive node that records every word on both Bus A and Bus B (with time stamps) for off-line analysis.

self_check_mechanisms: Manchester encoding self-clocked check (catches missing / wrong-polarity mid-bit transitions).
Sync polarity check (catches misframed words; cannot mistake Command/Status for Data).
Word-count vs received-Data-Word count cross-check (catches truncated / extended messages).
4-12 µs RT response window + 14 µs no-response timeout (catches missing or slow responses).
Initiate Self Test mode code (00011) triggers RT-internal BIT.
Transmit BIT Word mode code (10011) returns 16-bit RT health vector to BC.
Inter-message gap ≥ 4 µs sanity check on BC.
Dual-redundant bus retry (Bus A ↔ Bus B) provides single-fault tolerance.

error_count_thresholds.consequence: 1553B does not standardize a fault-confinement counter scheme like CAN. Integrators define their own retry limit + bus-error counters in the host BC software (typical: 3 retries before declaring an RT 'failed', plus immediate retry on redundant bus).

recovery_from_bus_off: Not applicable — 1553B has no bus-off state. A defective RT can be commanded into Transmitter Shutdown (mode code 00100) or Selected Transmitter Shutdown (10100). A defective BC is replaced by the Backup BC via Dynamic Bus Control (mode code 00000) or discrete failover.
rt_validation_test_plan: SAE AS4111 — RT Validation Test Plan (formerly MIL-HDBK-1553A Section 100, originally MIL-HDBK-1553 Appendix A). Comprehensive design-verification suite maintained by the SAE AS-1A Avionic Networks Subcommittee for RTs designed to AS 15531 and 1553B Notice 2.
rt_production_test_plan: SAE AS4112 — RT Production Test Plan. Simplified subset of AS4111 intended for in-line production testing of Remote Terminals.
notes: MIL-STD-1553B does not specify scan / JTAG / BIST at the silicon level. Protocol-level self-checking (parity + Manchester + sync polarity + word-count + response timing + Status Word condition bits + BIT Word mode code) plus dual-bus retry plus passive Bus Monitor + SAE AS4111 / AS4112 industry test plans give a comprehensive observability and validation envelope.
